title: The chain item that resolved this step was Herald of the Arcane's activated ability ('[1], [Exhaust]: Play a 1 Might Recruit unit token'), which the engine offered (step 31 action list) and let player-1 activate (step 32) while a Showdown was in progress at Abandoned Hall; it resolved now, creating a Recruit token in base during the showdown.
expected: Trace steps 31-34 confirm: showdown active at player-1-bf-unl-205-219 (focusPlayer player-1, isCombatShowdown false), step 32 activateAbility on player-1-legend-ogn-265-298 put a create-token Recruit ability on the chain, resolved by step 34 with showdown still active. Card def (riftbound-cards/src/cards/ogn/herald-of-the-arcane.ts:16-25) declares the ability with no keyword/timing. Engine: activate-ability.ts:39-50 `abilityTimingClass` returns "standard" only for gear hosts and otherwise defaults to "action" (line 49: `getCardType(hostCardId) === "gear" ? "standard" : "action"`), so a legend's keyword-less activated ability is treated as Action-timed; isLegalTiming (chain/chain-state.ts:207-208) then permits "action" in showdown-open, and the condition at activate-ability.ts:514-530 only additionally checks Focus. Rule 313.1.a text (verified via rule.ts): "A player with Focus may not play spells or activate abilities that don't have the Action or Reaction keywords." So the engine wrongly allows non-Action/Reaction, non-gear activated abilities during a Showdown Open State.
